messages:
Maria P.: Heads upwe need to schedule the postmortem + retro for last week's DB fail. Proposing Thu 11:00am PT, 45m. Draft agenda: 1) 5m customer impact summary, 2) 10m timeline, 3) 20m RCA deep dive, 4) 5m mitigation checklist, 5) 5m actions + owners. Who must attend? Eng leads, oncall, SRE, PM, security. Please react or suggest different times.

Jason K.: Thu 11 works for SRE. +1 on the mitigation checklist slot. Can we also reserve a 5m callout for rollback/playbook review? Might be useful.

Priya S.: I have an overlap at 11, prefer Thu 1pm PT. If most prefer 11, I'll watch recording. I can still present the RCA section.

Tomas (PM): Either time is ok. Request: first 5m should include a short customer-impact summary (incidents, affected regions, customer count) so PMs can triage comms.

Eve L.: I can own notes and the action tracker. I'll create cards in the incident board for each action with owner + due date.

Nora B.: Security can join for the first 10m if there are any PII/data concerns; otherwise optional. Add me as optional.

InfraVendorRep: Thanks for the invite, we'll try to join. Marking optional unless you specifically want vendor diagnostics included.

Maria P.: Thanks all. Quick poll: if >2 people object to Thu 11, we'll move to Thu 1. Otherwise I will book 11. Pre-reads: incident timeline doc (https://redwood.internal/incident/2025-06-db-fail) and blameless notes. Please skim.

Jason K.: Agenda tweak proposal: 5m customer impact, 10m timeline reconstruction, 15-20m RCA (include contri factors + logs), 5m mitigation checklist, 5m actions/next steps. Total 45m.

Priya S.: Fine with that agenda. I'll drop an RCA skeleton into the doc by tomorrow 12pm for comments.

Eve L.: Event created (Thu 11:00am PT, 45m). Invite includes eng-leads, oncall, SRE, Tomas, Nora, InfraVendorRep optional. Recording enabled. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Meeting created: "PM+SRE Postmortem (2025-06-DB-Fail)" Thu 11:00am PT  attendees added.

Maria P.: Final ask before I lock: everyone add one expected outcome on the event thread (e.g., concrete owner for each action, timeline for fix, follow-up review date). We'll close actions in 2 weeks. If you want specific diagnostics run before the meeting, add a comment.

Jason K.: I'll add the mitigation checklist and annotate where we've already applied short-term fixes.

Priya S.: Added note: RCA draft link + a short list of logs I want us to review.

Eve L.: I'll publish the action tracker after the meeting and ping owners. Planning a follow-up review in 2 weeks to validate fixes.

Maria P.: Great. If anyone wants to move the time, speak now or I'll book Thu 11. Otherwise see you then. Thanks.
